cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only trying to brighten the place up. Leave the rent letter for a moment; I'll choose where the new curtains go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The landlord wants an answer today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll send him a photograph first. I'll get the curtains hanging properly so he can see we're looking after his house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll send it and ask whether we're behind.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not with that carpet in the picture. Move the sofa under the window; I'll hold your phone and decide when the room's ready to send him.

reason: Replace explicit outcome boilerplate with a modest social contribution and concrete decisions. Preserve distinct loyalty, surrender, blame diversion, forbidden subject and protective-lie mechanisms; make B contribution determine the next tactic.
